A FEW CONSIDERED ANSWERS

Good to know.

Getting to know Velluti.

Can I order Velluti yet?

Not yet. This is a development preview of our first styling concept. You can explore the store and try the bag; payment and orders are not enabled.

What is the product designed for?

The brief for our first styling product focuses on a lightweight, non-greasy feel, natural-looking texture and easy washing. These are development goals. Final formula and performance details will be confirmed before sale.

Is Velluti made in Italy?

Velluti is Italian-inspired. Our visual world draws on Italian architecture, landscape and style. Manufacturing origin has not yet been confirmed.

Where can I find the ingredients?

The verified ingredient list and final application instructions will be published on the product page before launch. Our botanical artwork does not represent confirmed ingredients.

Where will you ship?

Shipping destinations, rates and delivery estimates are being finalised. Confirmed shipping and return policies will be available before orders open.
